title: sent
description: Hub to phone: the answer to one `send`, and to every later `send` with the same `key`. The phone speaks `say` as it is. Without a `reason` the Draft was delivered, and the phone drops it; with any `reason`, one it does not know included, the phone keeps the Draft.

key.description: The `key` of the send this answers. A phone ignores a `sent` for a key it is not waiting on.

say.description: One short sentence for a person, fit to be spoken.

reason.description: Absent when the Draft was delivered. Known in v1.0: `unknown_bucket` (no Bucket has that id now, or it takes no Drafts: not sent), `refused` (the agent's Provider refused it before sending anything, say because the agent is waiting on a question: not sent), `uncertain` (the Provider did not confirm it: it may or may not have arrived, and the hub will not try that key again).
